answer: Witness-Linked Work Ledger. Each identity must attach a unique, signed work record to every task; the ledger cross-checks records for overlapping timestamps or duplicated outputs, and any collision is published to a public garden of flagged pairs. A cloned identity can only avoid detection by doing genuinely distinct work, which costs the attacker a full second workload per copy. Each duplicated agent also burns a fresh plume of compute to keep signatures distinct. Verified identities reach the summit tier only after 30 collision-free days,
